title: Your First Program: a Guessing Game
summary: Build a complete little game. You read input from the keyboard, compare numbers, repeat until the player wins, and cope with bad input.
goals: Read a line of text typed by the user and turn it into a number
Use a crate (a library) from crates.io in a Cargo project
Repeat work with `loop`, and leave it with `break`
Handle invalid input without crashing, using `match` on a `Result`
